Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX Version for session, i.e. 'FIX.4.4'

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Number of bytes in the message body.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Identifies FIX message type.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number. Must be set to 'Y' for messages sent in response to a Resend Request from Coinbase Derivatives

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Connection identifier assigned by Coinbase Derivatives. This tag consists of 2 subcomponents: SubFirm ID and Session ID SubFirm ID is the left-most 3 characters. The next 3 characters represent Session ID. Example: EBR123 SubFirm ID: EBR Session ID: 123 From Exchange: Value from order entry tag 56-TargetCompID - "COIND"

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the end trader submitting orders. Tag 50 IDs are issued by an exchange clearing member firm (clearing member), their contracted vendors or assignees

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Can be used to identify the end trader submitting orders if Tag 50 is populated by a third party connection provider.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Timestamp of the message leaving the client system.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Identifies entity receiving the message = "COIND" From Exchange Connection identifier assigned by Coinbase Derivatives. This tag consists of 2 subcomponents: SubFirm ID and Session ID SubFirm ID is the left-most 3 characters. The next 3 characters represent Session ID. Example: EBR123

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Identifies destination exchange system - "PROD" or "TEST" From Exchange: Echo back Tag57 sent by client system

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For resent messages only, contains timestamp from tag 52-SendingTime from original message.

Field.Name: LastMsgSeqNumProcessed
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum (34) of the last message from the client received and processed by the gateway.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always last tag in message. Functions as end-of-message delimiter.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: "0" - None. Security must be guaranteed on transport level

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds - Allowed values are between 5s and 60s, 30s is recommended

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: "N" - use previous sequences "Y" - reset sequences (start new session). If clients cannot recover the previous session they start new session with 1 and set this field to "Y". The flag should be used with caution especially during trading session as this might lead to business data loss

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Logout reason

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the first message in range to be resent

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the last message in range to be resent

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: "N" - sequence reset, the counterparty must adjust inbound sequence number. "Y" - indicates the message is used instead of administrative or business messages which are not to be resent

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New adjusted sequence number

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier to be returned in resulting Heartbeat message

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier to be returned in resulting Heartbeat message

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the rejected message

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Error message

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Reject reason code. See Session Reject Reason Codes (tag 373).

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum <34> of rejected message

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text string.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Value of business-level "ID" of the message being rejected.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code identifying reject reason 0=Other 1=Unknown ID 2=Unknown security 3=Unsupported message type 4=Application not available 5=Conditionally required field missing 6=Not authorized 7=Delivery to firm not available at this time

Field.Name: SecurityUpdateAction
Field.Description: Included in the message on the Incremental feed when a mid-week deletion or modification (i.e. extension) occurs. 980=A: Add represents Security Definition messages that are: Newly added during the current week Disseminated during the Sunday Startup period Resent by the system during the week 980=M: Modify represents modifications to a Security Definition 980=D: Delete represents deletions of a Se

Field.Name: LastUpdateTime
Field.Description: Timestamp of when the instrument was last added, modified or deleted. UTC Timestamps are sent in number of nanoseconds since Unix epoch synced to a master clock to microsecond accuracy.

Field.Description: This field provides the calendar month reflected in the instrument symbol (tag 55-Symbol in MDP 3.0; tag 107-SecurityDesc). Format YYYYMM (e.g., 201912) For futures spreads and options spreads, this field contains the first leg's calendar month reflected in the instrument symbol.

Field.Description: 2=Commodity/Agriculture 4=Currency 5=Equity 12=Other 14=Interest Rate 15=FX Cash 16=Energy 17=Metals 99=Crypto

Field.Description: 21 = Pre Open 27 = Pre Open (No Cancel) 17 = Ready to Trade 2 = Trading Halt 4 = Close 99 = Pause 18 = Expired 98 = Forbidden

Field.Name: MinPriceIncrement
Field.Description: Minimum constant tick for the instrument.

Field.Name: UnitOfMeasure
Field.Description: Unit of measure for the product's original contract size. This will be populated for all products listed on Coinbase Derivatives. USD unit of measure can be in U.S. dollars or cents.

Field.Name: UnitOfMeasureQty
Field.Description: This field contains the contract size for each instrument. Use in combination with tag 996-UnitofMeasure. For example: Euro futures -Tag 1147=10000 -Tag 996=Euro For variable-quantity products, the contract size reflects the original contract size, before the application of the multiplier

Field.Name: HighLimitPrice
Field.Description: Allowable high limit price for the trading day. A key parameter in validating order price. Used as the upper band for validating order prices. Orders submitted with prices above the upper limit will be rejected. This price protects off prices for quoting. Note: This value is indicative only and may not reflect the actual real-time high limit price.

Field.Name: LowLimitPrice
Field.Description: Allowable low limit price for the trading day. A key parameter in validating order price.

Field.Name: MaxPriceVariation
Field.Description: Differential value for price banding.

Field.Name: SettlPriceType
Field.Description: Type of settlement price. The value of 2 (Theoretical) will be sent during the initial seeding of a new contract. This tag is sent in conjunction with Tag 734 (PriorSettlPrice)
